project_type: React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + Vite SPA with Supabase backend
build_system: Vite with tsc for type checking. Path alias @/ -> src/
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: npx vitest run. Both must pass with zero errors.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Use 'unset NODE_OPTIONS' before running any node commands.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running node/vitest/tsc due to sandbox proxy bootstrap issue. No Supabase connection at runtime (tests mock supabase).
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters). All new stores/components need tests. Follow existing patterns for supabase mocking.

key_patterns.stores: Zustand create<Store>((set, get) => ({...})) pattern. Separate State and Actions interfaces. Export as useXStore hook.
key_patterns.supabase_access: Use fromTable('table_name') helper from @/lib/supabase. Mock with vi.mock('@/lib/supabase').
key_patterns.types: Database interfaces in src/types/database.ts. Enums with string values. camelCase interface fields matching snake_case DB columns.
key_patterns.components: Functional components with inline styles. data-testid attributes for testing. Conditional rendering based on canvas mode.
key_patterns.testing: vi.mock for supabase, useStore.setState for state setup, @testing-library/react for component tests, direct store method calls for store tests.

directory_structure: frontend/src/: App.tsx, main.tsx, test-setup.ts. Subdirs: canvas/, components/ (Toolbar, SkuBrowser/, ZonePropertiesPanel, MeasurementPanel), hooks/, lib/ (supabase.ts), stores/ (authStore, canvasStore, projectStore, skuStore), types/ (database.ts, canvas.ts, index.ts)
